collision_registry.note: Original task IDs preserve paired coverage; collisions are not independent repetitions.

interpretation: Reused8source streams,48related cases; models share one training initialization and some checkpoints. Not independent replications.
Original physical IDs retain task pairing; transformed prompt collisions are disclosed and never counted as independent evidence.
Compilation is privileged execution by an interpreter, and support selection is query-specific oracle evidence. Success does not show the LLM can learn either process.
Improvement can reflect easier text, changed positions, reduced interference, explicit numerical values or distribution effects, not uniquely relation composition.
Failures on transformed text also do not prove composition incapacity or memory injury. Preserve role-specific harms and strongGDNonly control.
